name: FirstEnergy
description: FirstEnergy is a holding company for electric wires utilities (Ohio Edison, Cleveland Electric Illuminating, Toledo Edison, FirstEnergy Pennsylvania, JCP&L, Monongahela Power, Potomac Edison) that deliver electricity to over six million customers across about 65,000 square miles in Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Maryland, New Jersey and New York, plus the high-voltage transmission companies of FirstEnergy Transmission (FET, 49.9% owned by Brookfield). It is almost entirely regulated delivery: only West Virginia (Monongahela Power, 3,610 MW) still owns generation. State and FERC regulators set the rates, so earnings grow with the rate base it invests in; the company is 100% electric, with no gas utility.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities' and Sub-Industry 'Electric Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

hq.note: EDGAR business address: Akron, OH; Wikipedia S&P 500 list also Akron, Ohio

employees.note: All in the US; 4,887 are bargaining-unit employees (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Distribution
businessLines.how: Customers pay state-set distribution rates every month; revenue also passes through the cost of purchased power (purchased power was $2,458M in 2025), so profit comes from the allowed return on the delivery rate base, not from selling power.
businessLines.description: Ohio Companies (Ohio Edison, Cleveland Electric Illuminating, Toledo Edison) and FirstEnergy Pennsylvania: delivery of electricity to about 4.3 million customers in Ohio and Pennsylvania.

operatingProfit.note: Earnings attributable to FE (the segment profit measure); revenue less operating expenses is $582M. FY2025 includes a $275M Ohio settlement charge and $352M impairment from the Ohio rate order (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1031296/000103129626000046/fe-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Integrated
businessLines.how: Regulated rates for delivery and transmission plus, in West Virginia, regulated rates covering the fuel and capital cost of Monongahela Power's own generation (fuel $652M, purchased power $2,105M in 2025); profit is the allowed return on the rate base.
businessLines.description: JCP&L (New Jersey), Monongahela Power and Potomac Edison (West Virginia, Maryland): distribution and transmission, plus Monongahela Power's regulated generation (3,610 MW controlled including AGC), serving about 2 million customers.

operatingProfit.note: Earnings attributable to FE; revenue less operating expenses is $817M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1031296/000103129626000046/fe-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Stand-Alone Transmission
businessLines.how: FERC formula rates reset each year for the actual cost of the lines plus an allowed return on equity, paid by PJM transmission customers; there is no commodity exposure.
businessLines.description: FirstEnergy's 50.1% interest in FirstEnergy Transmission (ATSI, MAIT, TrAIL; Brookfield owns 49.9%) and KATCo: high-voltage lines in PJM, more than 24,000 miles across the company.

revenue.note: FY2024 $1,787M; mostly forward-looking FERC formula-rate revenue (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1031296/000103129626000046/fe-20251231.htm)

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $1,787M; mostly forward-looking FERC formula-rate revenue (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1031296/000103129626000046/fe-20251231.htm)

operatingProfit.note: Earnings attributable to FE after $251M attributed to the Brookfield noncontrolling interest; revenue less operating expenses is $899M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1031296/000103129626000046/fe-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Corporate/Other
businessLines.how: Not an operating business: parent-company interest and costs that the utilities' earnings must cover.

brands.name: Ohio Edison, Cleveland Electric Illuminating, Toledo Edison
brands.note: 1.1 million, 0.8 million and 0.3 million customers; rate base $2.0B, $1.7B and $0.5B at Dec 31, 2025

brands.name: FirstEnergy Pennsylvania
brands.note: About 2.1 million customers in Pennsylvania (plus about 4,000 in Waverly, New York); rate base $6.9B

brands.name: JCP&L (New Jersey)
brands.note: About 1.2 million customers; distribution rate base $3.7B plus transmission $1.4B

brands.name: Monongahela Power (West Virginia) and Potomac Edison (Maryland, West Virginia, Virginia)
brands.note: About 0.4 million customers each; Monongahela Power also owns regulated generation

brands.name: FirstEnergy Transmission (ATSI, MAIT, TrAIL) and KATCo
brands.note: FirstEnergy holds 50.1% of FET; Brookfield 49.9%. ATSI has 7,965 circuit miles and a FirstEnergy-owned rate base of $2.3B

whatsNext.text: Ohio Companies filed a three-year base-rate plan May 22, 2026 for test periods starting July 1, 2027: +$254M in year 1, +$59M year 2, +$80M year 3, asking 10.2% ROE on 53% equity; evidentiary hearings begin March 1, 2027

Monongahela Power and Potomac Edison filed a CPCN Feb 13, 2026 for the 1,200 MW Maidsville combined-cycle gas plant plus 70 MW of solar, about $2.7B, with a financing-cost surcharge during construction
Pennsylvania default-service plan filed Feb 3, 2026 for the June 1, 2027 to May 31, 2031 delivery period
